First checks: Reprint the label; clean the scanner window; check battery; test with a known good barcode
Likely causes: Damaged or faded label; dirty scanner; low battery; scanner paired to the wrong workstation
Escalate when: Scanner fails known good barcodes on two workstations

First checks: Check the order status; check scheduled times against the pass window; confirm resident location and status
Likely causes: Order unverified; order timed outside the pass window; resident on leave or transferred; duplicate therapy hold
Escalate when: Order is verified and active and the medication still does not present

First checks: Note the exact step where it froze; check wireless signal at that spot; try a second workstation
Likely causes: Building wireless dead zone; device fault; system or network wide slowdown
Escalate when: Every cart slows at the same time (treat as one system ticket)

First checks: Confirm both nurses documented in the same record; check for a dose under the wrong resident or pass; pull the audit trail
Likely causes: Documentation in the wrong chart; missed sign-off; genuine count variance
Escalate when: Support never edits records to balance a count; nursing leadership and pharmacy resolve

Symptom: Resident missing from the pass list
First checks: Confirm admission is complete; check resident status and location; check for a pending transfer
Likely causes: Admission not finalized; transfer in progress; status set to discharged in error
Escalate when: Admission shows complete and the resident is physically present

Symptom: MAR shows a dose already signed that was not given
First checks: Pull the audit trail for who signed and when; check for a shared or unattended session
Likely causes: Accidental sign-off; session left open and used by another staff member
Escalate when: Any pattern of sign-offs by a user who was not on shift

First checks: Check paper and ribbon; check the print queue; confirm the default label printer for the cart
Likely causes: Empty media; queue jammed by a failed job; wrong default printer after a cart swap
Escalate when: Printer fails after media and queue are cleared

First checks: Compare entry times and prescribers; check whether one is a renewal of the other
Likely causes: Verbal order entered twice; renewal plus original both active
Escalate when: Never discontinue from support; route to pharmacy and the prescriber

First checks: Check the interface queue for held messages; confirm the order was transmitted
Likely causes: Held or errored interface message; order never sent; result filed to the wrong chart
Escalate when: Message errored with a code support cannot clear

Symptom: User locked out at med pass
First checks: Verify identity per policy; check lockout reason; reset or unlock
Likely causes: Repeated failed logins; password expired; role changed
Escalate when: Lockouts repeat after reset (possible account or device problem)

Symptom: Offline or sync warning on the cart
First checks: Check connectivity first; note the last successful sync time; do not sign off doses until sync state is understood
Escalate when: Sync backlog grows or doses documented offline cannot be reconciled

Symptom: Wrong resident context open during documentation
First checks: Stop; verify the correct chart; check whether anything was saved under the wrong resident
Likely causes: Two similar names on the unit; rushed chart switching
Escalate when: Anything was saved: route to nursing leadership and follow the chart correction process
